summary: The two-day rally ran out of gas. Soft retail sales at -0.6% and a weak Michigan sentiment print at 51.0 took the wind out of stocks, and both indices flipped short on their trend stops for the first time in the run. MNQ closed -0.20% at 30,155 and MES -0.30% at 7,802, each a touch under a falling stop. This was rotation, not panic: gold reversed an overnight flush to 4,332 and closed +0.56% at 4,398 to reclaim its stop, while crude firmed +1.49% to 82.41 on the Iran supply premium. VIX eased under 14, so a pause and a rotation, not a fear event, with the geopolitical story the thing to watch into the weekend.
psychology: Yesterday's note warned against pressing a third green day just because the trend looked obvious. Today the market faded exactly that trade. Anyone who chased longs into the open got a lower close and a stop flip. The lesson repeats: when your trend stop flips, you respect it, you do not argue with it. The other one for a Friday with a live geopolitical headline is size. Trim into the weekend, do not add. You cannot manage a gap you are overexposed to on a Sunday night.

event.name: July Retail Sales + prelim UMich Sentiment
event.consensus: Retail Sales about +0.1% m/m; UMich sentiment about 54.5
event.nqReaction: NQ failed at 30,272, reversed to a 30,025 low, and closed -0.20% at 30,155, flipping short on its trend stop for the first time in the two-day run.
event.crossAsset: VIX eased about 4% to under 14. Gold reversed the overnight flush to close +0.56% and reclaim its stop; crude firmed +1.49% on the Iran supply premium. The 10-year yield rose toward 4.70% on the geopolitical headline despite the soft data.

observe.name: AVWAP Hand-off (short)
observe.note: NQ and ES broke their opening ranges down at 14:20 UTC and handed off to a lower afternoon toward the 30,025 and 7,796 lows before a late bounce. The day's cleanest session edge.

observe.name: AVWAP Deviation Band
observe.note: Gold tagged roughly -3 sigma on the overnight flush to 4,332 and reverted hard to close +0.56% and reclaim its stop. A textbook mean-reversion long from exhaustion.

risk.sizing: Lighter size on the index momentum book. Both indices flipped short in one session, a fresh one-day-old signal, so favor confirmation over conviction.
risk.openRisk: Long side has rotated to metals and energy (gold reclaimed long, crude firm). Index shorts are one session old and whipsaw-prone.
risk.note: The main risk is the weekend: the Iran naval-blockade story lifted crude, gold, and yields today and can gap the tape Sunday night, so trim overnight and weekend exposure. Week ahead: Monday brings Empire State manufacturing (8:30 AM ET) and NAHB housing (10:00 AM ET), both second-tier. Keep size measured until Monday confirms the flip or reclaims it. Not financial advice.
